name: Claude - Call Stream With Skills
description: Anthropic-only streaming webhook with Files API for generating .docx, .xlsx files

parameters.content:
## Claude - Call Stream With Skills

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/claude-call-stream-with-skills

**Description:** Streaming Claude avec Files API - le plus complexe des 4 webhooks.
Combine streaming par paquets + génération de fichiers.

**InputSchema:**
```json
{
  "required": ["api_key", "model", "messages", "container", "callback_url", "correlation_id"],
  "properties": {
    "api_key": { "type": "string" },
    "model": { "type": "string" },
    "betas": { "type": "array", "default": ["files-api-2025-04-14"] },
    "system": { "type": "string" },
    "messages": { "type": "array" },
    "max_tokens": { "type": "integer", "default": 16000 },
    "container": { "skills": [...] },
    "callback_url": { "type": "string" },
    "correlation_id": { "type": "string" },
    "stream_config": {...},
    "metadata": { "type": "object" }
  }
}
```

**Output (immediate):** { status: 'streaming', correlation_id }
**Callbacks:** Packets to callback_url, final packet includes files
